fusions.name: Choking Grit
fusions.desc: A cloud of acrid grit that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Warning Shot of Slag
fusions.desc: Lobs a lump of reeking slag that deals 32 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Bitter Rebuff
fusions.desc: Each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tainted Hide
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and you have 10% poison resistance.
